title: site.json
description: A content site's placement config: what the site-template assembler reads from `site/site.json` to write the deployable Next app. Every object is closed, so a misspelt key is an error rather than a silent no-op. Paths are relative to `site/` unless a key says otherwise.

$schema.description: Editor hint only; the assembler ignores it.

output.description: The app directory the assembler writes, relative to the site repo's root, e.g. `websites/main`. Its parent is the pnpm workspace root.

port.description: The local dev server's port: `next dev -p <port>`, and the origin `frameSiteUrl` falls back to.

theme.description: A key of the template's `themes.json`: the theme stylesheet and the fonts it needs.

tokens.description: The site's token sheet, e.g. `theme.css`. Only custom-property declarations inside `:root { }`; it is appended after the theme and the frame sheets.

mark.description: The hero's mark. Absent: `/glyph.svg` (content-buildr's glyph) as a glyph.

themeColor.description: The mobile browser chrome's colour; track the theme's ground.

ogImage.description: The Open Graph image's public path. Absent: the mark's `src`.

jsonLd.description: Structured data, rendered as one `application/ld+json` script in the root layout.

slots.description: Custom components by the place in the frame each fills. The value is a file under `site/components/` and its export, `file.tsx#Name`. A `band:<id>` key must name a section of `src/landing.json`.

drawer.description: Drawer rows after the section rows.

dependencies.description: Extra npm dependencies, name to version range. Naming a dependency the template already has is refused.

toolkitPackages.description: Extra toolkit packages, as directories under the toolkit's `packages/web/packages/` (e.g. `releases`, `features/bitbag`), linked into the app.

fonts.description: Fonts beyond the theme's: one `next/font/local` family each, exposed as its CSS variable on `<html>`.
